title: CS 4944
description: A one-credit senior seminar for computer science majors, usually covering professional topics such as careers, research, graduate study, and the role of computing in society.
notes: Virginia Tech's catalog entry for CS 4944 (Seminar) has no description text, so the description is generic.

title: Natural Science Elective
description: A laboratory science course from a two-semester sequence, such as general biology, general chemistry, or physics, each with a lab.
notes: VT: BIOL, CHEM, or PHYS sequences.

title: MATH 2534 or MATH 3034 (Introduction to Discrete Mathematics)
description: A course on mathematical reasoning: logic, proof techniques, sets, functions, relations, and induction, as either a discrete mathematics course or an introduction to proofs.
notes: Choice slot: VT's MATH 2534 or MATH 3034. Official descriptions are in data/raw/vt/ (courses-math page).

title: Pathways General Education (Concept 2, 3, 6a, or 7)
description: A general education course in the humanities, social sciences, or the arts, chosen from a university-wide list.
notes: VT Pathways Concepts 2, 3, 6a, and 7 (7 suspended from Fall 2025).

title: MATH 2204 or CMDA 2005 (Introduction to Multivariable Calculus)
description: A course in multivariable calculus (partial derivatives, multiple integrals, vector calculus), or an integrated quantitative-sciences course that covers it alongside other topics.
notes: Choice slot: VT's MATH 2204 or CMDA 2005. Official descriptions are in data/raw/vt/ (courses-math, courses-cmda pages).

title: Communications Elective
description: A course in oral communication, such as public speaking or communication in teams.

title: Advanced Natural Science Elective
description: A further natural science course beyond the first-year sequence, often with a lab, in a field such as biology, chemistry, physics, or geosciences.

title: CS 3000-5000 Level Elective
description: An upper-level computer science elective chosen by the student.
notes: VT: 6 credits at the 3000 level or above.

title: Professional Writing Elective
description: A course in professional or technical writing, such as technical writing, editing, documentation, or writing for digital media.
notes: VT: one of seven ENGL courses.

title: Statistics Elective
description: A course in probability and statistics for engineers or scientists: probability models, estimation, hypothesis testing, and regression.
notes: VT: one of several STAT courses.

title: CS Theory Elective
description: An upper-level theory course, such as algorithm analysis, formal languages and automata, theory of computation, or quantum computation.

title: CS Technical Elective
description: A technical course in or related to computing, chosen from a list that includes courses in other departments, such as machine learning, numerical methods, cryptography, or data analytics.

title: CS Capstone
description: A senior capstone course in which students complete a substantial team project in an area of computing, such as software engineering, systems, security, human-computer interaction, or data.
notes: VT: one capstone from a list.

title: CS 4000-5000 Level Elective
description: An upper-level computer science elective chosen by the student, at the 4000 level or above.
